From the rigorous selection of raw materials to exhaustive clinical testing, every detail is scrutinized by our research team. We embrace the rapid evolution of the skincare industry by continuously upgrading our technologies, ensuring that our clients always receive the most advanced, world-class care available.

Freezing Time, Revealing Perfection

Our elegantly designed packaging does more than just preserve the potency of our active ingredients; it serves as a testament to our meticulous craftsmanship and respect for beauty. Our ultimate promise is to freeze the passage of time and halt the signs of aging. By focusing on the unique needs of every woman, CONI empowers you to transcend the challenges of time, revealing a version of yourself that is confident, unique, and eternally radiant.

Everyone deserves a good chair.

Would you wear a formal dress to swimming or a swimsuit to work?

Yes, you wouldn't. So, what chair do you choose to support your profession during long work hours? Or is the office chair, which has close contact with your body, not one you chose yourself?

Everyone spends a third of their day sitting in a chair; however, do you know what kind of chair your spine needs? Is the "ergonomics" advertised actually useful?

We all mistakenly believe that sitting is easier than standing. In fact, when sitting, the pressure on the lumbar spine is twice that of standing. If the body leans forward 20 degrees, the pressure on the lumbar spine is almost three times the original pressure. Therefore, the consequences of choosing the wrong chair are worse than choosing the wrong partner!

Prolonged poor posture causes muscles to overcompensate, leading to spinal compression and twisting, resulting in muscle tension, stiff shoulders and neck, lower back pain, lower limb edema, chronic fatigue, and symptoms such as digestive and respiratory problems, chest tightness, headaches, and palpitations. It also significantly alters physical appearance, causing hunchback, shrugged shoulders, and a sunken chest—the antithesis of beauty and style.

Everyone deserves a good chair, to enjoy top-notch, high-quality ergonomics, create a comfortable working environment, and achieve a fulfilling and prosperous life. Professional support, we are your strongest backing.

秉持"沟通（Communication）"这一品牌理念，ODEAR 关注人们在一天开始与结束时所经历的细腻情绪变化与肌肤状态变化。品牌不盲目追随传统化妆品趋势，而是致力于开发能够自然融入日常生活、并带来清晰可感知效果的产品。ODEAR 坚持严格的开发原则——只有在功效经过验证、且具有实际意义的情况下，产品才会正式上市。
基于深厚的配方研发实力与成分科学理解，ODEAR 打造兼具功能性功效与可持续设计的高性能护肤产品。品牌将与消费者的持续沟通视为核心增长战略，通过快速反馈与不断优化建立信任关系。因此，ODEAR 已在韩国市场树立起高度可信赖的专业护肤品牌形象。
在创意总监 Park Ah-In 的带领下，ODEAR 已建立起超过 210,000 人规模的影响者与消费者社群（截至 2024 年 5 月），成为推动品牌自然增长与高用户参与度的重要动力。

來自泰國的香氛品牌 MITH，相信氣味不只是感官體驗，更是一種能喚醒記憶與情感的力量。
那些深藏於童年與成長歲月中的幸福片段，往往伴隨著愛、溫暖、笑容與笑聲，即使時光流逝，依然能在某個瞬間被重新喚起。對 MITH 而言，香氣正是連結記憶與情感的重要媒介。

MITH 品牌的創立初衷，正是希望成為承載美好回憶的象徵。品牌相信，許多珍貴的往日時光，也許會隨著時間漸漸模糊，但當熟悉的氣味再次出現，那些曾經令人感到幸福的畫面與情緒，也會隨之回到心中。透過香氛，MITH 希望帶領人們重新回到那些快樂、純粹且真摯的時刻。

品牌名稱 MITH，同時也蘊含多重意義。除了代表 Made in Thailand，展現品牌源自泰國的背景與精神外，在泰文的發音中，「MITH」也有著 朋友、友誼 的意涵。對品牌而言，氣味就像一段真誠的關係，不僅能傳遞溫度，也能拉近人與人之間的距離，讓香氣成為情感交流的一部分。

MITH 希望每一款香氣，都不只是單純的香水，而是一段關於記憶、情感與連結的延伸。當人們聞到某種氣味時，想起的或許是一個人、一段時光，或是一個曾經讓自己感到幸福的瞬間。這正是 MITH 所想傳遞的品牌價值：讓香氣成為美好記憶的入口，也成為情感延續的載體。

Childhood memories that have never faded with happiness, love, warmth, smiles, and laughs leading to delighted emotion when these have been recalled.

MITH brand is established with its hope to be the representative reflecting happy memories of past days that seem to fade over time and returning to the happy memories.

MITH is the abbreviation for made in thailand.the way to pronounce a word “mith” in thai language also means friend or friendship and good fragrance conveys the meaning of good friendship.
